question: What is the most chaotic thing that has ever happened at your job?
story: My entire company spent three weeks building a product for a client that did not exist. It started when a huge project landed in our inbox from a company nobody had heard of. Big budget, tight deadline, extremely polite emails. Our boss was thrilled. Twelve of us dropped everything and built the whole thing from scratch. Late nights, weekend calls, catered dinners, the works. Then the invoice bounced. Turns out an intern had been practicing with a fake sample project and accidentally sent it to the real team inbox. He watched in silent horror as grown adults poured three weeks into his homework assignment. He finally confessed on day nineteen, crying in a conference room. Here is the twist. What we built was genuinely good. Our boss packaged it up, sold it to an actual paying client, and made more than the fake one ever offered. The intern got a full time job. We got pizza.
